definition: The option this style reaches for by default for this slot. A slot may have more than one: a Georgian roof is canonically a side gable or a hip.
basis: schema/kit.schema.json, on a variant's status: "canonical: the default a generator should reach for." kits/georgian-colonial-american.kit.json marks both side-gable and hip canonical under roof_form, whose rule reads "The roof is one simple solid about one ridge, of equal pitch on all slopes".
